children: Mistral pulled in 3 billion at a post-money valuation above 21 billion, delivering Europe's largest private technology equity round. Samsung Electronics (SSNLF), the memory-chip and consumer-electronics powerhouse, jointly led the financing as its shares edged 0.2% lower to 269,500 won.

The numbers are aggressive. The fresh capital represents roughly 14.3% of Mistral's new valuation, pointing to a pre-money price tag near 18 billion. With the French AI developer targeting $1 billion in annual recurring revenue by year-end, investors are effectively paying approximately 24 times that prospective revenue stream.

Samsung did not reveal the size of its check, and the investment does not automatically put new chip orders in its pocket. Still, Mistral's expansion across AI models, advanced research and computing infrastructure should create an enormous appetite for memory and processing power. Samsung's 91 out of 100 GF Score strengthens the setup: exceptional growth, financial strength and profitability offset a weaker valuation profile, while middling momentum suggests the market has not fully embraced the story yet.

title: Samsung Leads Europe's Record 3 Billion AI Round--and Shares Slip
